A simple greeting.
Watch the two tones: 6, then 3.

cards.back: ngo5 giu3 aa3 gaai1 · My name is Jia.
cards.gloss: 我叫… means My name is…
Often used when receiving a gift.

cards.back: m4 goi1 · thanks (for a service) / excuse me
cards.gloss: Use with shop staff and waiters; 多謝 is for gifts.
Add your name after 叫.

cards.back: gung1 zok3 ging1 jim6 · work experience
cards.gloss: Useful in interviews.
NOT min6 si1 / si2. Second syllable is tone 3 (試).

cards.back: gung1 zok3 ging1 jim6 · work experience
cards.gloss: Four tones: 1-3-1-6. Say each number in your head once.

cards.back: ngo5 lai4 min6 si3 · I’ve come for the interview / I’m here for an interview.
cards.gloss: 嚟 = lai4 (spoken). Full phrase for the door.

cards.front: 試 si3 vs 事 si6
cards.back: 試 si3 = try/test (in 面試). 事 si6 = matter/affair. Mid level vs low level.
cards.gloss: 面试用 試 (3)，不是 事 (6)。

cards.back: Spoken Cantonese prefers 嚟 lai4; 來 is the written form. Same meaning: come.
cards.gloss: 口語用嚟，書面用來。Say: ngo5 lai4…

cards.back: ngo5 giu3 Fu6 Gaai1 · My name is Fu Jia.
cards.gloss: 我叫傅佳。叫 giu3 = 叫做

cards.back: ngo5 hai2 Gong2 Daai6 duk6 zo2 sing4 si5 fan1 sik1 · I studied urban analytics at HKU.
cards.gloss: 喺 hai2 = 在; 咗 zo2 = 了

cards.back: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 · I like data analysis.

cards.front: 我好想加入你哋嘅團隊。

cards.back: si4 gaan3 · time (多謝你嘅時間 = thanks for your time)
